breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the polar moment for torsion, explicitly stating J = πd^4/32 for all calculations, and applies torsion formulas with J for both shear stress and twist. It does not repeat the incorrect instruction to use bending moment I.
